subject: battles
text: The player can restart battles from the beginning when you die, so you never get game over.

evidence.quote: The cool thing (?) about Mystic Quest is the fact that you can restart battles from the beginning when you die, so you never get game over.

subject: Behemoth
text: The Behemoth is easy, but he can do critical attacks, and if he does one, and you don't do any, chances are you will die.

evidence.quote: The Behemoth is easy, but he can do critical attacks, and if he does one, and you don't do any, chances are you will die.

subject: man in blue
text: Pushing the boulder causes the man in blue to give you the Tree Wither.

evidence.quote: push the boulder. You're his new Tajiri (japanese for hero), so he gives you the Sphere of Light (or the Tree Wither, you decide).

subject: chest
text: A chest in Level Forest contains cure potions.

evidence.quote: stealing some cure potions from the chest.

subject: Kaeli
text: Talking to Kaeli in the house in the lower right hand corner results in her joining your party.

evidence.quote: Go into the house in the lower right hand corner and talk to Kaeli. After an outstandingly fun scene, she will join your party.

subject: top house
text: Going through the back door in the top house using stepping stones in the water allows you to get the Cure spell from the house.

evidence.quote: Go through the back door in the top house (use the stepping stones in the water), and get the Cure spell from the house.

subject: Minotaur
text: Minotaur has 240 Hit Points and gives 102 Experience and 30 Gold Pieces.

evidence.quote: MINOTAUR...Hit Points: 240...Experience Given: 102...Gold Pieces Given: 30

subject: Minotaur
text: Having Kaeli cast Life on Minotaur will do a lot more damage.

evidence.quote: Have Kaeli cast Life on Minotaur and it will do a lot more damage.

subject: Minotaur
text: Being on Level 3 makes the battle against Minotaur a lot easier.

evidence.quote: If you are on Level 3, this battle will be a lot easier, believe me.

subject: Kaeli
text: Kaeli will give you the Axe to chop up trees.

evidence.quote: Kaeli will then give you the Axe, so you can use that to chop up trees and crap.

subject: Heal potions
text: Heal potions refill when you leave, allowing you to stock up on Heal potions before you go.

evidence.quote: Stock up on Heal potions here before you go, just keep going back in and getting more. They refill when you leave.

subject: Tristam
text: Tristam has taken the Elixir, but promises he will give it to you if you take him through the Bone Dungeon to get some treasures.

evidence.quote: Tristam has taken the Elixir, but he promises he will give it to you if you take him through the Bone Dungeon to get some treasures.

subject: Battlefield #1
text: Battlefield #1 is located North of Level Forest with Mad Plant and Poison Toad enemies and offers Reward: None.

evidence.quote: BATTLEFIELD #1...Location: North of Level Forest...Enemies: Mad Plant, Poison Toad...Reward: None

subject: Battlefield #2
text: Battlefield #2 is located West of Sand Temple and gives Charm as a reward.

evidence.quote: BATTLEFIELD #2...Location: West of Sand Temple...Reward: Charm

subject: 1F chests
text: Chests on 1F are located on both the left hand side, right hand side, and in the middle.

evidence.quote: Get the chests on both the left hand side, right hand side, and in the middle, then go in.

subject: Tristam
text: Tristam will leave you at the end of 1F and you have to come back by yourself.

evidence.quote: Tristam will leave you at the end here and you have to come back by yourself.

subject: bombs
text: When you buy the bombs off Tristam, say no the first time he asks to get them cheaper.

evidence.quote: buy the bombs off Tristam. Say no the first time he asks to get them cheaper.

subject: hole
text: Blow up the hole you skipped over to get the Steel Shield.

evidence.quote: blow up the hole you skipped over, to get the Steel Shield.

subject: B2 right chest
text: On B2, go right and get the chest.

evidence.quote: B2: Go right and get the chest.

subject: B2 long skeleton
text: Use the bomb on the long skeleton and go right to get some Ninja Stars.

evidence.quote: use the bomb on the long skeleton. Go right and get some Ninja Stars, then go left.

subject: skeleton head chest
text: Bomb the skeleton head and go all the way up to get the chest.

evidence.quote: Go up and bomb the skeleton head. Go all the way up, and get the chest.

subject: B2 Quake spell
text: Going all the way up on the left side of B2 allows you to get the Quake spell.

evidence.quote: Go down, then left. Go all the way up here to get the Quake spell, then go right, and keep going.
